note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'takes off' through each defender's name to 'Kimmich scores' (the ball in the net): keep the pauses at '...'. Chapter 2: 'inside, outside' each paint one change of direction, 'full speed' the burst. Chapter 3: 'He looks up' draws the sight line to Kimmich, 'cuts it back' the pass.

chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Lisbon, 2020, an empty stadium. Alphonso Davies takes off down the left wing. Past Messi, past Vidal! Now Semedo... he's past him! Cut back... Kimmich scores!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Semedo waits. Davies dances: inside, outside, then full speed down the line! One quick turn, he's in the box.

chapters.label: The cut-back
chapters.text: He looks up and cuts it back. Joshua Kimmich side-foots it in! Bayern went on to win eight to two.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: on the wing, use your pace and quick changes of direction, then look up and cut it back!
